stories.title: Strategy sells 1,638 Bitcoin to fund dividends and STRC buybacks
stories.summary: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) sold 1,638 BTC along with some MSTR stock, raising about $395 million, to cover shareholder dividends and repurchase $81 million of its STRC preferred shares. The company also said it built its cash reserve up to $4 billion. It's a rare sale from a firm best known for relentless bitcoin accumulation.
stories.whyItMatters: Strategy is the largest corporate bitcoin holder, so any disposal — even one aimed at funding obligations rather than signaling a strategy reversal — gets scrutinized as a read on its balance-sheet health and capital structure.
whatToWatch: Whether Strategy resumes net BTC buying in coming disclosures
Pace and size of further STRC repurchases
Trajectory of the $4 billion cash reserve
questions: Does this mark a shift from pure accumulation toward active liquidity management?
How much more STRC will be bought back, and over what timeframe?

stories.title: Trump Media's bitcoin stash may now be loan collateral after $165M wallet move
stories.summary: About 5,278 BTC associated with Trump Media disappeared from on-chain trackers following a $165 million wallet transfer, according to CryptoSlate and CoinDesk. The move suggests the coins may now be pledged as collateral against a loan rather than held as a freely disclosed treasury position.
stories.whyItMatters: Trump Media's bitcoin treasury draws outsized attention given its political profile, and a shift to loan collateral changes how liquid or exposed that position actually is.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of any loan or collateral arrangement
Regulatory filings disclosing the transaction
Further movements from the same wallets
questions: What loan, if any, is the BTC now backing?
Does Trump Media still control the coins, or has custody changed?

stories.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market funds for stablecoin reserves
stories.summary: BlackRock rolled out blockchain-based tokenized money market funds designed to serve as reserve assets for stablecoin issuers, according to Cointelegraph and CoinDesk. The move extends BlackRock's tokenization push from its existing funds into infrastructure built specifically for the stablecoin ecosystem.
stories.whyItMatters: A major asset manager building reserve products tailored to stablecoins signals traditional finance is now designing directly for crypto infrastructure, which could influence how stablecoin backing is held and audited.
whatToWatch: Which stablecoin issuers adopt the new funds
Regulatory reception to bank-grade reserves on-chain
questions: How do fees and terms compare to BlackRock's traditional money market funds?
Which blockchains will the funds ultimately support?

stories.title: Hashdex to close its smallest Bitcoin ETF after two-plus years
stories.summary: Hashdex plans to shut down its smallest Bitcoin ETF after more than two years in operation, according to Cointelegraph. The report doesn't detail the fund's assets or the specific reason for closure.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF closures point to consolidation pressure in an increasingly crowded Bitcoin ETF market, where flows are concentrating in a small number of larger funds.
whatToWatch: Timeline for closure and investor redemptions
questions: Why did this particular fund underperform?
Will Hashdex wind down other smaller products too?

stories.title: Italy's largest bank slashes Bitcoin ETF call position 99%, adds to staked Ethereum
stories.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo, Italy's biggest bank, cut its Bitcoin ETF call option position by about 99% while increasing its exposure to staked Ethereum, according to CryptoSlate.
stories.whyItMatters: A rotation by a major European bank away from bitcoin options and toward staked ether is a notable institutional sentiment signal, and a data point on relative appetite for the two largest crypto assets.
whatToWatch: Future regulatory disclosures showing the size of the staked ETH position
Whether other banks show similar rotations
questions: What's driving the shift — a yield play, a price view, or risk management?
How large is this position relative to the bank's total holdings?

stories.title: BlackRock's new tokenized money market funds go live on Solana and Ethereum
stories.summary: Decrypt reports BlackRock's newly launched tokenized money market funds are operating on both the Solana and Ethereum blockchains, adding on-chain settlement to its cash-management lineup.
stories.whyItMatters: Launching on two major chains rather than one suggests BlackRock is hedging its blockchain infrastructure bets, which could drive institutional activity on both networks.
whatToWatch: Adoption and volume on each chain
Whether additional blockchains are added later
questions: How are reserves and custody split or synced across the two chains?
Is there interoperability between the Solana and Ethereum versions?

stories.title: Dormant since 2013, a bitcoin wallet just moved $31 million — and it's not alone
stories.summary: CoinDesk reports a bitcoin wallet inactive since 2013 moved roughly $31 million worth of BTC, and other long-dormant wallets have also shown recent activity.
stories.whyItMatters: Movement of deep-cost-basis, long-held coins is closely watched by traders as a potential signal of incoming supply or notable ownership changes.
whatToWatch: Whether the moved coins are sent to exchanges
Further activity from other old wallets
questions: Who controls these wallets, and why move now?
Is the activity coordinated across multiple dormant addresses?

stories.title: Coldcard-linked bitcoin thefts top $100M across three attack waves, Galaxy finds
stories.summary: Cointelegraph reports that thefts connected to Coldcard hardware wallets have surpassed $100 million in stolen bitcoin, spanning three confirmed waves of attacks, per research from Galaxy.
stories.whyItMatters: A theft total in the hundreds of millions tied to a widely used self-custody hardware wallet is a serious security incident that could shake confidence in cold-storage devices generally.
whatToWatch: Coldcard's response or any security patch
Additional victim disclosures
Possible law enforcement involvement
questions: What attack vector was used — supply chain compromise, seed extraction, or phishing?
Are current-generation Coldcard devices still vulnerable?

stories.title: American Bitcoin tops 8,000 BTC after record mining quarter
stories.summary: Decrypt reports that American Bitcoin, the mining venture tied to the Trump family, has surpassed 8,000 BTC in holdings following a record quarter of mining production.
stories.whyItMatters: The Trump family's direct stake in a bitcoin miner keeps political and financial crypto exposure intertwined, drawing scrutiny alongside the family's other crypto ventures.
whatToWatch: Next quarterly production and treasury update
Whether holdings continue to grow or are partly sold
questions: How much of the 8,000 BTC is retained versus sold to fund operations?
What's the current profitability of the mining operation?

stories.title: American Bitcoin posts record BTC output, narrows Q2 loss
stories.summary: Cointelegraph reports that Trump family-linked miner American Bitcoin recorded its highest-ever bitcoin production in the latest quarter while narrowing its net loss, according to its Q2 results.
stories.whyItMatters: The financials indicate whether the mining-first strategy is becoming more sustainable, which matters given the political attention on Trump-family crypto businesses.
whatToWatch: Path toward profitability in coming quarters
Future treasury disclosures alongside production figures
questions: What drove the narrower loss — higher bitcoin prices, lower costs, or both?
When, if ever, does the company expect to turn profitable?

stories.title: Bitmine adds $19.6M in ETH, buys back 4.5M shares
stories.summary: Cointelegraph reports that Bitmine purchased an additional $19.6 million worth of ether and repurchased 4.5 million of its own shares.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitmine has been among the more aggressive corporate ether accumulators, so continued buying paired with share buybacks signals management confidence in both ETH and its own stock.
whatToWatch: Bitmine's total ETH treasury size after this purchase
Continuation of the buyback program
questions: How is Bitmine financing these purchases?
What is the company's total ether holding now?

stories.title: Mastercard completes $1.8B acquisition of stablecoin firm BVNK
stories.summary: Cointelegraph reports Mastercard has closed its $1.8 billion acquisition of BVNK, a stablecoin infrastructure company, extending the payments giant's push into stablecoin rails.
stories.whyItMatters: A major card network taking direct ownership of stablecoin infrastructure signals stablecoins moving further into mainstream payment rails, with implications for settlement speed and competitive dynamics in payments.
whatToWatch: Timeline for integrating BVNK into Mastercard's network
Which stablecoins and chains the combined business supports
questions: How will BVNK's products be branded or merged into Mastercard's offerings?
What regulatory review, if any, accompanied the deal?
